text:
morgan: kicking off v1.12.3 rollout, deploy-bot shows canary -> 50% ok. quick post-deploy smoke started. noticing p95 jump on synth in eu-west1, anyone else seeing that?

deploy-bot: deploy v1.12.3 -> prod (canary=50%) completed. smoke-suite started. prefill-warmup probe running. status: partial-success.

ben: saw the same. kv-prefill probe p95 jumped from ~0.36s -> ~1.4s around 12:04 UTC. small window but sustained ~10m.

jia: digging into logs now. running: `kubectl logs -l app=smokebridge -n prod --tail=300 | rg "prefill|timeout"` — seeing repeated `kv warmup miss` lines at 12:04:21, 12:05:03, 12:06:10.

morgan: can we pin eu-west1 traffic back to the previous variant while we triage? canary fallback is enabled but i'd prefer manual pin for safety.

ben: agree. plan: pin embed route in eu-west1 to v1.12.2, then re-run targeted synth against canary for repro. i'll wait for oncall ok.

sre-oncall: oncall here. give me 2 mins to check monitoring dashboards (errors, cpu, mem). watching for >5% error or p95>1.2s.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite partial results: p95 by region for prefill probe -> eu-west1=1.42s, us-west1=0.32s, apac=0.29s. configured fail threshold=1.0s.

jia: correlating telemetry — prefill cache miss rate spiked at same time. sample log: ```ERROR kv_warmup: missing-prefill key=mdl::embed::prefill at prefill.py:87``` no OOMs, just misses.

morgan: ok hold rollout + pin. ben, please run the pin and update release notes with the decision and rationale (short).

ben: executing pin: `redwoodctl pin --region eu-west1 --route embed-v1 --variant v1.12.2` -> stdout: "success: route embed-v1 pinned to v1.12.2 in eu-west1" :thumbsup: notifying console and owners.

ben: updating release notes: "paused canary in eu-west1 due to elevated prefill probe latency caused by cache warmup misses; pinned to v1.12.2 pending root-cause investigation." added link to internal runbook <https://redwood.internal/runbooks/prefill-warmup>.

morgan: thanks. next step — can we create a focused synthetic that repeatedly triggers the prefill path (small batch, repeated keys) so infra can reproduce without full traffic? want to run it against v1.12.3 in eu-west1.

jia: on it. will draft a short test in infra-tests and push a branch. snippet i'll run locally: ```for i in {1..500}; do curl -s -X POST https://canary-eu.embed/internal/prefill -d '{"seed":$i}'; done```

sre-oncall: sounds good. i'll escalate if the repro causes >5% user-facing errors. otherwise i'll maintain watch.

deploy-bot: smoke-suite followup: after pin, eu-west1 prefill p95 dropped to 0.33s and miss-rate normalized. closing the immediate hold.

morgan: good catch everyone. follow-up action items: (1) infra to add a targeted prefill warmup test to nightly, (2) ops to add a short cooldown/hysteresis on canary prefill probe thresholds, (3) create a small postmortem if repro confirms a regression. assigning owners in the ticket.

ben: created ticket INFRA-2291 for the synthetic and threshold tuning. leaving notes in release-trail.

jia: pushed test draft to infra-tests branch `prefill-repro/182999`. tagging @infra for review.

sre-oncall: standing down but watching for alerts. ping me if anything regresses.

deploy-bot: thread closed by smoke-suite check at 1829994510.
